citation.title: Human metabolome and immunomodulatory effects of 36 h of fasting: plasma metabolites that mimic fasting effects on macrophages and extend lifespan in C. elegans

population.description: 20 young healthy participants, 10 men and 10 women, recruited at UC Davis; included if aged 20-40 y, BMI 19-27 kg/m2, fasting glucose 70-100 mg/dL, no documented health conditions (enrolment criteria, not observed ranges, so min and max are null). Age 27.5 +/- 4.35 y (Table 1 and Results). BMI is printed twice: 24.3 +/- 3.1 in Table 1 (used here) and 24.1 +/- 2.66 in the Results text; the two disagree and the paper does not say which is right.

protocols.name: fasted_12h
protocols.description: Baseline blood draw at approximately 08:00 after an overnight (12 h) fast, day 1 (state A); a short fasted morning arm, the sample read at the end of 30 minutes, water not restricted ('habitual water consumption')

protocols.name: fasted_38h
protocols.description: Blood draw at approximately 08:00 on day 3 (state C, '36-h fasted'). Hours without food: last meal at 18:00 on day 1; 18:00 day 1 to 08:00 day 3 = 14 h + 24 h = 38 h. The paper's '36 h' counts from the 20:00 day-1 postprandial draw (20:00 to 08:00 two days later = 36 h), after the 18:00 meal; 38 h since food is derived from the printed times. Water habitual; no food or calories; only strenuous exercise was prohibited. Short arm, sample read at the end of 30 minutes

findings.description: Plasma glucose (NMR LipoProfile of EDTA plasma) at baseline after an overnight 12 h fast, state A

location.where: Table 2, row 'Glucose (mg/dL)', column Baseline (A); footnote: Values are presented as mean ± standard deviation. n = 20

findings.description: Plasma glucose (NMR LipoProfile of EDTA plasma) at 08:00 on day 3, the '36-h fasted' state C (38 h since the last meal)

location.where: Table 2, row 'Glucose (mg/dL)', column Fasted (C); footnote: Values are presented as mean ± standard deviation. n = 20

left_out.what: glucose in the fed state (B, 2 h after the 18:00 day-1 meal) and re-fed state (D, 2 h after the 18:00 day-3 meal) (Table 2): the meals were each participant's own habitual diet from a food record; no content is printed in the paper (Supplemental Table 1 is not in the full text)

ketone bodies in all four states (Table 2, umol/L, NMR LipoProfile): total ketone bodies, not beta-hydroxybutyrate; the separate BHB values in the text and Figure 3C (1.16 +/- 1.36 vs 19.8 +/- 10.8) are Metabolon relative abundance, not a concentration
triglyceride by NMR in four states (Table 2)
cholesterol (total, LDL, HDL) by NMR in four states (Table 2)
NMR amino acids (a.u.) and GlycA (Table 2), and the untargeted plasma metabolome, macrophage and C. elegans results
